data_facts_with_para.paragraph: ['To give you an idea of just how cheap, we’ve put together a list of some of our favourite dishes and how much you can expect to pay for them.', 'The following are guide prices based on eating at a standard restaurant – the kind of no-frills, no-nonsense eateries the locals use. As with anywhere, you can pay a lot more than we’ve suggested – and you can probably find it cheaper too, from markets and street food carts.', 'Cost: around 50-60,000 VND (USD $2.05-2.50 / £1.60-1.95)', 'Cost: around 20-25,000 VND (USD $0.80-1.00 / £0.65-80)', 'Cost: around 20,000 VND (USD $0.80 / £0.65) (large snack size)', 'Cost: around 20,000 VND (USD $0.80 / £0.65) per portion fresh or 30,000 (USD $1.25 / £1) fried', 'Cost: around 40-50,000 VND (USD $1.65-2.05 / £1.30-1.60)', 'Cost: around 20,000 VND for a portion (USD $0.80 / £0.65)', 'Cost: around 225,000 VND per person ($9.25 / £7.30)', 'Cost: around 40-50,000 VND (USD $1.65-2.05 / £1.30-1.60)', 'Cost:', ' * 8-10,000 VND (USD $0.30-0.40 / £0.25-35) for bia hoi', ' * 10-15,000 (USD $0.40-0.60 / £0.35-0.50) bottled', ' * At the most expensive places you might pay up to around 100,000 VND ($4.10 / £3.25) for a beer – still cheaper than a Londoner’s wildest dreams!']
